tui_gateway/AGENTS.md.new:
`apps/shared` (`JsonRpcGatewayClient`). New RPC = a new `methods_<topic>.py` or an entry in an
existing topical sibling, registered in the table — no `if method == ...` chain (root shape rules).

Per-turn hidden notes: `prompt.submit` accepts an opaque `note` param (sanitized, 8 KiB cap) that is
merged ONLY into the model-facing `api_content` (one-shot `agent._gateway_turn_context_notes`,
consumed in `agent/turn_context.py`) — the durable user row/transcript stays exactly as typed.
ASK-mode notes are SANDWICHED for primacy+recency: the same note also leads the run message
(`run_message = _prepend_note(run_message, note)`, gated on the `[mode:ask]` head) while the slot
still trails it. Session auto-titles read `agent._persist_user_message_override` first, so API-only
scaffolding never leaks into a title.
`session.note.stage` stages the NEXT prompt's note one-shot (TTL 30 s) for clients that cannot add
submit params (Desktop `composer-modes` bridge); the busy path carries notes through the queue
envelope (last note wins).
